bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
sha=eb13afd5e7091c394f99c5a84cd346422cea90d6
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/tgtumbler-gserver-deploy-20261106 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo STK04_INSPECT_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 71; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/stk04-inspect-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$sha" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
podman build --quiet -f "$d/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t localhost/gace-stk04-inspect:eb13afd5 "$d" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_INSPECT_IMAGE_BUILD_FAILED; exit 72; }
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_INSPECT_GROUP_BOT_AMBIGUOUS; exit 73; }
name="$names"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || { echo STK04_INSPECT_BOT_NOT_RUNNING; exit 74; }
if podman run --rm --entrypoint cat localhost/gace-stk04-inspect:eb13afd5 /app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs | docker exec -i -e STICKER_PIN_MODE=inspect "$name" node --input-type=module -; then
 echo STK04_INSPECT_READ_ONLY_COMPLETE
else
 echo STK04_INSPECT_READ_ONLY_FAILED
 exit 75
fi
